about: Two people share your mic, two people on the other side.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Morning. Dave is here with me in the office, so there are two of us on this side.

truth.speaker: Kristin
truth.text: Hi Dave, good to hear you. Shall we start with the plugin directory?

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Yes please. We added search yesterday, and it already finds all two thousand plugins.

truth.speaker: Norman
truth.text: I saw it. It's fast, but the install button still copies the old command.

truth.speaker: Dave
truth.text: That's on me, I'll fix it after this call.

truth.speaker: Kristin
truth.text: Great. Then the second thing is the newsletter. It goes out on Friday.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Who is writing the intro this time?

truth.speaker: Dave
truth.text: I can do it. I have a draft about running Omarchy on a potato PC.

truth.speaker: Norman
truth.text: Can you add a screenshot of the new lock screen?

truth.speaker: Dave
truth.text: Sure, I'll take one this afternoon.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Good. Kristin, anything from the forum this week?

truth.speaker: Kristin
truth.text: Only one thing. Three people asked how to go back to the default theme. We should make that easier to find.

truth.speaker: Norman
truth.text: I can add it to the theme menu, right at the top.

truth.speaker: Dave
truth.text: Then I think we're done. Thanks everyone.
